value.name: Pomona Choice Energy
value.notes: Pomona Choice Energy is the City of Pomona's own Community Choice Aggregation (CCA) program (not Clean Power Alliance), confirmed directly via its own official site (pomonachoiceenergy.org): 'a locally-managed, not-for-profit energy provider created by the City of Pomona as an alternative to Southern California Edison.' Began serving residential accounts October 2020. Default plan is 'Pomona Choice'; optional tiers include 'Pomona Choice 100' (100% renewable) and 'Pomona Solar Choice'. SCE continues to handle service start/stop, billing, and outages.

county.notes: Pomona is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Pomona/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: pomonaca.gov and library.municode.com both returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, blocking access to Pomona's solar submittal requirements.

eligibility_constraints.notes: The city is understood to offer SolarAPP+/Energov automated review for residential roof-mounted PV, per search-engine summaries, but no size-cap or property-type figure could be independently confirmed via direct fetch this session.
